prohibited_substitutions: AGI >= USD 1 million tax returns are annual-income returns, not millionaire persons
Joint returns and households are not individual people
Liquid investable assets exclude items included in total net worth
Primary work/business location does not establish primary residence
Citizenship or a second home does not establish state residence
IRS wealth >= USD 11.4 million does not enumerate all >= USD 1 million adults
Forbes 400 does not enumerate all >= USD 1 billion persons
Property, parcel, building, campus, company and tax project counts are separate
BUILT/Completed, approved plans and permits do not independently establish current operation
A national or state value must not be copied into counties
No matching record or a blocked source is not a zero population count
deduplication_rules: People require a stable provider person ID and one location snapshot; relatives/family fortunes must follow the source treatment
Retain facility source IDs, dated status and unit; names alone never justify a cross-source merge
EPA: row descriptive fingerprints are temporary snapshot identifiers, not persistent facility identities
Texas: owner/operator/occupant registration suffixes are roles; multiple stems, reused stems, program conversions and malformed dates go to review
Minnesota: hash-pinned manual PDF transcription; a changed PDF requires a newly dated reviewed transcription
Loudoun existing parcels: one PA_MCPI if component statuses agree; retain floor-area conflicts
Loudoun building footprints: FID is snapshot identity, not a globally stable building ID
Loudoun GIS layers have different units and vintages and must not be summed
Label-year certifications cannot be added into unique facility totals
Raw values, flags, URL, source date, retrieval time and SHA-256 remain attached to all observations
